notes: Portable C++ primary/contract and Java parity use only IEEE 1516.1-2025 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador surfaces. The adapter supplies the provider package or JAR, FOM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time implementation. One timestamped directed send reaches a nonconstrained recipient as receive-order while remaining queued for a constrained recipient. Retraction issues one matching Request Retraction to the delivered recipient and suppresses delivery and retraction callbacks for the still-pending recipient through its Time Advance Grant. The separate immediate-only ledger, alternate advances, independent providers, and conformance are not claimed.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador sendDirectedInteraction(time), retract, timeAdvanceRequest; FederateAmbassador receiveDirectedInteraction(time), requestRetraction, timeAdvanceGrant
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 timestamped directed interaction and retraction surfaces
